lines.text: She just gave the best speech!

data.define: To do something extremely well or look amazing doing it.

misuse.text: Don't say 'slay' in a serious meeting.

hook.text: She just gave the best speech!

publish.title: What does "slay" mean?
publish.value: Slay = You did that really well. Example: "You slayed that speech!" (very casual English, US).
